name: lembaranz
description: Lembaranz is a local-first, zero-knowledge encrypted vault for credentials and secret notes, designed for terminal power users. It provides a premium TUI experience and a robust core engine for managing secrets without ever relying on the cloud. Everything is encrypted locally using AES-256-GCM and Argon2id (OWASP Hardened 64MB), ensuring that your most sensitive data—from API keys to secret notes—stays entirely under your control.
benefits: Data Sovereignty: Zero-knowledge architecture ensures that secrets never leave the user's local machine, providing absolute privacy.
Professional-Grade Security: Hardened with 64MB Argon2id for brute-force resistance and atomic writes to prevent database corruption during power loss.
Developer Flow: Terminal-first design (Ink/React) allows developers to manage, search, and inject credentials/env-vars seamlessly without leaving their workspace.
Zero-Latency Reliability: Works 100% offline with no server dependency, providing instant access to secrets with local-first persistence.
